description: This file defines a Java class named ExternalEventConfigurationUpdateHandler which implements the CommandHandler interface to handle external event configuration update requests within the Fineract project. It uses Spring annotations for component scanning and transaction management, and leverages Lombok for boilerplate code reduction.

classes.name: ExternalEventConfigurationUpdateHandler
classes.description: A handler class that processes external event configuration update commands, delegating the update operation to a service.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the command to update external event configurations and returns the response after invoking the write platform service.
